summary: Frontend-only bug fix verification for CarteMap native crash (Expo Go). Static code inspection + web preview runtime tests both PASS. CarteMap.tsx has been correctly refactored to use lazy require() inside try/catch for react-native-maps, react-native-map-clustering, and expo-location, with a mapsAvailable flag and conditional list-fallback branch. On web preview (localhost:3000), the .web.tsx variant is served (verified via 'Carte native disponible sur mobile' header + list of Itinéraire buttons). Zero pageerror events, no red screen, back navigation returns to dashboard cleanly. Metro bundler logs show no CarteMap-related errors — only benign expo-notifications/shadow* deprecation warnings.
action_items: (Informational, not a regression from this fix) Direct navigation to /etablissements/carte while unauthenticated does NOT redirect to /login on web — the page renders publicly. If gating is desired, add an auth guard in app/etablissements/carte.tsx. Does NOT block the current bug fix (no crash observed).

(Pre-existing, out of scope) Numerous console warnings across the app: 'shadow*' props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), Animated useNativeDriver falls back to JS on web. These are cosmetic and not caused by this fix.
critical_code_review_comments: CarteMap.tsx correctly uses `let ... = null` + try/catch require pattern (lines 17-37). mapsAvailable flag drives conditional fallback at line 89. This is the recommended Expo Go-safe pattern.
Fallback branch (lines 89-118) reuses openMapsDirections from NearbyEstablishments — good DRY, and the yellow warning bandeau clearly communicates the mode to the user.
grep confirmed 0 static imports of react-native-maps / react-native-map-clustering / expo-location in CarteMap.tsx.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The native crash fix on CarteMap can only be *fully* validated on a real device / dev build with react-native-maps installed. Web preview only exercises CarteMap.web.tsx. Code inspection of the .tsx (native) variant confirms the try/catch + require + mapsAvailable + fallback branch pattern is correctly in place — this is the standard Expo Go safety pattern and should prevent the reported native crash.
rca_of_issue: Original crash: static ES `import` of react-native-maps at top of CarteMap.tsx triggered a native module resolution at bundle-parse time in Expo Go, which does not embed react-native-maps → RN runtime raised a red-screen 'application closed due to bug'. Fix: replace all three static imports (`react-native-maps`, `react-native-map-clustering`, `expo-location`) with `require()` calls wrapped in a single try/catch. On failure, mapsAvailable stays false and the component renders the pre-existing list fallback (same UX as web). Reproduction: prior code base with `import MapView from 'react-native-map-clustering'` opened in Expo Go → immediate native crash. Mitigation: retested in web preview (CarteMap.web.tsx served) — no crash, no page error, list + Itinéraire buttons render. Native validation requires an EAS/dev-client build.
